newsitem.title: USA: Above median precip. in S.Great Plains in Dec - NWS.
newsitem.headline: Above median precip. in S.Great Plains in Dec - NWS.

text.p: The National Weather Service on Thursday said it expects above-median precipitation in December for the Southern Great Plains, including the area from Southeastern New Mexico and West Texas to Oklahoma.
Iowa and Southeastern Nebraska may also experience above-median precipitation but areas in the Northwest may have a drier than normal month, it said in its December outlook.
The service said it was only able to make predictions regarding temperature for Alaska, which it said would experience below-median temperatures in the western and central parts of the state.
The next 30-day outlook will be issued December 19.
